name: School Portal
description: Student portal with sign in / sign up, a verified profile and a class schedule.

name: Quiz App
description: Quiz system with admin, teacher and student roles. Teachers build subjects, categories and quizzes; students join a class by code and answer with copy-paste and tab switching blocked.

name: Library Management
description: Library system with a searchable book catalog, borrow and return with due dates, overdue tracking, and an admin who adds books and sees all loans.
